name: file-next
description: File-system components for Next.js — file browser, uploader, actions, and supporting primitives built on @vryzel/file-next-headless.
author: file-next contributors

items.name: file-browser
items.title: File Browser
items.description: List files with keyboard navigation, loading and error states. Built on useFileBrowser from @vryzel/file-next-headless.

items.name: file-uploader
items.title: File Uploader
items.description: Dropzone + button with keyboard support, real progress and cancel. Built on useUploader from @vryzel/file-next-headless.

items.name: file-actions
items.title: File Actions
items.description: Delete / move / copy menu with optimistic update + rollback. Built on useFileActions from @vryzel/file-next-headless.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: File Breadcrumbs
items.description: Folder path segments with click-to-navigate. Keyboard accessible.

items.name: file-preview
items.title: File Preview
items.description: Image preview for image mime types; lucide icon for everything else.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: File Empty State
items.description: Placeholder shown when a folder has no children. Built on shadcn Empty.

items.name: error-state
items.title: File Error State
items.description: Error banner shown when list / upload fails. Built on shadcn Alert.

items.name: file-explorer
items.title: File Explorer
items.description: Full file-browser orchestrator: list/grid views, context menu, drag-drop, breadcrumbs. Built on useFileExplorer from @vryzel/file-next-headless.

items.name: file-icon
items.title: File Icon
items.description: Mime-type-aware file/folder icon. Lucide with wildcard fallback for image/*, text/*, audio/*, video/*.

items.name: explorer-list-view
items.title: Explorer List View
items.description: Table view with sortable columns (Name, Size, Modified, Kind). Drag-drop + right-click enabled.

items.name: explorer-grid-view
items.title: Explorer Grid View
items.description: Card-grid layout for the file explorer. Each file is a square card with icon + name + size. Drag-drop + right-click enabled.

items.name: explorer-toolbar
items.title: Explorer Toolbar
items.description: View-mode toggle (list | grid) for the file explorer. Accessible button pair.

items.name: explorer-context-menu
items.title: Explorer Context Menu
items.description: Right-click context menu: Open, Rename, Move to, Copy to, Delete. Radix ContextMenu under the hood.
